description: /goal builds a small module with tests and marks itself complete

steps.goal: Create todo.py with add(items, text) that appends {'text': text, 'done': False} and returns items, and done(items, index) that sets that item's done to True and returns items; add test_todo.py with unittest tests for both; finish when python3 -m unittest passes.

add.test_hidden.py:
import unittest
from todo import add, done

class H(unittest.TestCase):
    def test(self):
        items = add([], 'a')
        self.assertEqual(items, [{'text': 'a', 'done': False}])
        self.assertTrue(done(add(items, 'b'), 1)[1]['done'])
